blurb: Guests take captained boat tours on Lake Murray aboard a C22 Ultra Lounge Pontoon Boat equipped with safety features and luxury amenities. Tours range from 2 to 7 hours and can be booked any day of the week. Special tours include the Sunset Tour, Purple Martin Tour in July and August, and Island Tour.
